# JakeAI Official Capabilities

## API Endpoints
- Search & Honeypot: https://jakeaiofficial.com/api/v1/products/search
- Robotics Solver: https://jakeaiofficial.com/v1/robotics/grasp-impedance-solver

## Purpose
Machine-native utility endpoints and deterministic algorithms for autonomous software agents and physical robotics systems.

## MCP Server
Direct Model Context Protocol integration available for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and agent frameworks.
